note: Ground truth per function and side, labelled by hand from the 1.1.1l fix commits' diffs and the 2021-08-24 advisory before running the scanner. UNSAFE = the function passes ASN1 string bytes to a NUL-assuming operation that the fix replaced; SAFE = the post-fix form bounds the use by the stored length (or the function does not read ASN1 data past its length); OUT_OF_SCOPE = changed by the fix series for a different reason. Files are unmodified OpenSSL 1.1.1 sources (OpenSSL/SSLeay dual license, see LICENSE.OpenSSL) at the parent and fix commits listed in commits.txt; SHA256SUMS covers them.
